load_task_script: load a single task script module by template id or full file path from the task scripts directory
load_task_scripts_from_folder: load all task builder scripts from a folder and return template id path and module tuples
load_tasks_from_folder: load task builders from a folder execute them and return an ordered dict of task id to Task objects
load_compiled_task_dict: load compiled task dump from lzma compressed pickle files and return a dict mapping task id to Task
load_compiled_task_list: load a list of Task objects by task ids from the default compiled task dump files
